title: discovery.rs: probe client rebuilt every round, not reused
description: kithd/src/discovery.rs: run_discovery_round() calls build_probe_client() on every discovery round, constructing a new rustls::ClientConfig, HttpsConnector, and hyper Client each time. The client is then shared within the round (the prior per-probe-task TLS alloc fix), but discarded at the end of the round. For large tailnets with a 5-minute interval this is harmless, but the OnceLock pattern already used in kithd/src/peer_fetch.rs (TAILNET_CLIENT) would be cleaner — build once at process start, reuse across rounds. Consequence: minor inefficiency and inconsistency with the peer_fetch.rs pattern.
